about_blocks.text: Recovery Acres is a rehabilitation center made for men only. It focuses on rehabilitating and on reintegrating the addicts in the community. The facility can take up to 34 men at the same time, which is pretty good. The program lasts a total of eight weeks during which the addicts go through a comprehensive educational program. They learn about the different aspects of addiction and are also taught about life skills such as communicating, solving problems, etc. There are also a lot of group meetings that are mandatory. The staff at that rehab center also helps the addicts find a job or a school depending on what the addict needs, so that they are ready when they get back out into the world.
